answer: The document is worthless; the timeline is everything. Property deed tenure works because a deed held in the same name since 2009, and a deed is a public record that has been sitting in a land registry for fifteen years, witnessed by solicitors who have since retired. The nebula is that public record - anyone can read it, no one can backdate it. The zephyr is the chain: each transfer leaves a signature, a fee, and a date, and a forged link breaks the chain in front of a clerk. The shale is the cost of building a fake chain: fifteen years of fake transfers, per alias, each one a separate crime.
